name: AutoKuma
description: AutoKuma is a utility that automates the creation of Uptime Kuma monitors based on Docker container labels. With AutoKuma, you can eliminate the need for manual monitor creation in the Uptime Kuma UI.

paths.name: AutoKuma static monitor configurations
paths.description: Path to the directory containing static monitor configurations

variables.name: Uptime Kuma URL
variables.description: URL of the Uptime Kuma instance to add monitors to

variables.name: Uptime Kuma username
variables.description: Uptime Kuma username, required if auth is enabled

variables.name: Uptime Kuma password
variables.description: Uptime Kuma password, required if auth is enabled

variables.name: Uptime Kuma MFA token
variables.description: Uptime Kuma MFA token, required if MFA is enabled

variables.name: Uptime Kuma tag name
variables.description: The name of the AutoKuma tag, used to track managed containers

variables.name: Uptime Kuma tag color
variables.description: The color of the AutoKuma tag

variables.name: Docker label prefix
variables.description: The prefix for Docker labels that AutoKuma should look for

variables.name: On deletion action
variables.description: The action to take on the Uptime Kuma monitor when a container is deleted

variables.name: Uptime Kuma headers
variables.description: Comma-separated list of HTTP headers to send when connecting to Uptime Kuma

variables.name: Uptime Kuma connection timeout
variables.description: The timeout for the initial connection to Uptime Kuma, in seconds

variables.name: Uptime Kuma call timeout
variables.description: TThe timeout for executing calls to the Uptime Kuma server, in seconds

variables.name: Static monitor configuration paths
variables.description: Path to the directory inside the container containing static monitor configurations
